dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Flat U-shape profile at the posterior margin with an asymmetrical taper towards the lower limbs.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, occupying approximately 35-40% of the visible dorsal-ventral length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate gap, roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the visual width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded, smooth semicircular apex on both visible pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-grey discoloration and matting of the fur on the posterior hindquarters; presence of a single linear organic debris (twig) on the right-hand side of the white mid-dorsal fur.
